_doc: Foley spotting list. shot + src = clip source time of the sync point (cutlist converts to timeline). lead = J-cut seconds before picture allowed.

cues.prompt: Small porcelain espresso cup gently set down on a saucer on a wooden table, single soft clink
Crisp close-up click of an old plastic wall light switch being pressed off, single sharp mechanical click, dry, high quality foley
Satin ribbon pulled loose, a rigid gift box lid lifted off, delicate tissue paper rustling, close-up luxury unboxing foley
Apartment front door closing softly with a latch click, then a small bunch of keys jingling
Smartphone placed face-down on a stone kitchen counter, single soft tap
